d: Guy Fieri turns up the pressure in Guy's Grocery Games with an odd-couple ingredient challenge that pushes chefs to rethink their cooking strategies. When fresh plums meet smoky bacon, the contestants must find a way to balance sweet, tart, and savory flavors in a winning dish. From crispy bacon to rich plum glazes, this cooking competition tests creativity, technique, and the ability to turn unexpected ingredients into restaurant-style plates.
